summary.text: Gaylon Kent is the Libertarian Party candidate for Colorado's 2nd District. He is a writer who lives in Hayden, works as a hotel night auditor and hospital security officer, and served in the U.S. Navy in the 1980s. He has run for federal office as a Libertarian several times and describes himself as the "peace candidate."

paragraphs.text: Kent was born in Los Angeles, California, and earned a high school diploma from Los Angeles Lutheran High School.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1983 to 1987.
He works as a writer and author; in his 2026 survey he says he also works as a hotel night auditor and in hospital security, and lives in Hayden, Colorado.
In his 2024 survey Kent says he was the Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate in 2014 and for U.S. House in District 3 in 2016 and 2018, and the Libertarian nominee in this district in 2024.
Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the American Legion as of 2024.
